entries.title: Now says what a crewmate is actually doing
entries.body: A crewmate's Now line, on its summary and its task's record, shows what it is doing at this moment: the sentence it last wrote, or what it said its newest command, read, edit or search was for. Messages sent to the crewmate, such as a finished background job or a checks reading, stay in Activity and no longer take over Now. When a crewmate has done nothing since, Now keeps its last doing with its real age, so a crewmate that stopped looks stopped.

picture.alt: A crewmate's summary whose Now line reads Run the journey alone after the fix, its age now
